notes_for_editor: Only three short listings were found, none with a build date, design, height or staffing. The permission access level and tribal status come from the record; the listings we read name only the reservation. A search summary suggested the Red Lake reservation lies mainly in Beltrami County rather than Koochiching; this was not verified, so the story says boundaries were not checked. The Koochiching County tower booklet on Wikimedia Commons (Koochiching_County_Towers.pdf) has no Indian Pines entry, checked by full-text search.
